human_understanding_delta: The sharp mixed chart has four certified active contacts, not an uncontrolled degeneracy. Their points are one common scale times sqrt(5)+i, i(sqrt(3)-1), -sqrt(5)+i, and -i(sqrt(3)+1). The corresponding three-parameter gradients form an affinely independent tetrahedron whose barycentre is exactly zero. Hence every nonzero amplitude/phase perturbation strictly improves at least one connector to first order; nondegenerate double-contact curvature absorbs the quadratic Taylor remainder and proves a genuine open neighbourhood selector theorem.
